description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

> This parameter is required only when WAF is deployed in hybrid cloud mode. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the IDs of Hybrid Cloud WAF clusters.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The ID of the threat detection or security event for which you want to query operation records.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

description.zh:
操作记录类型，取值：
- **abnormal**：表示风险检测。
- **event**：表示安全事件。
description.en:
The type of the operation record. Valid values:

- **abnormal**: threat detection.

- **event**: security event.

title.zh: 查询API安全用户操作记录
